macros.name: DTLaddtoplotlegend
macros.doc: This command is used by \DTLplot to add the current plot stream to the legend.

macros.name: DTLcustomlegend
macros.doc: This command is used to position the legend with the legend=custom setting.

macros.name: DTLformatlegend
macros.doc: The legend code is encapsulated with \DTLformatlegend.

macros.name: DTLmajorgridstyle
macros.doc: The style of the major grid lines is given by \DTLmajorgridstyle.

macros.name: DTLmaxX
macros.doc: When used within the \DTLplot hooks, this command will expand to the maximum x value of the plot bounds.

macros.name: DTLmaxY
macros.doc: When used within the \DTLplot hooks, this command will expand to the maximum y value of the plot bounds.

macros.name: DTLminorgridstyle
macros.doc: The style of the minor grid lines is given by \DTLminorgridstyle.

macros.name: DTLminorticklength
macros.doc: The length of the minor tick marks is given by \DTLminorticklength.

macros.name: DTLmintickgap
macros.doc: Dimension used to obtain the suggested minimum tick gap if not overridden by x-tick-gap or y-tick-gap or x-tick-points or y-tick-points.

macros.name: DTLminX
macros.doc: When used within the \DTLplot hooks, this command will expand to the minimum x value of the plot bounds.

macros.name: DTLminY
macros.doc: When used within the \DTLplot hooks, this command will expand to the minimum y value of the plot bounds.

macros.name: DTLplot
macros.doc: Creates a plot (inside a tikzpicture environment) of all the data given in the databases listed in ⟨db list⟩.

macros.name: DTLplotatbegintikz
macros.doc: Hook used at the start of the tikzpicture environment within \DTLplot.

macros.name: DTLplotatendtikz
macros.doc: Hook used at the end of the tikzpicture environment within \DTLplot.

macros.name: DTLplotdisplayticklabel
macros.doc: Formatting used for default x tick labels.

macros.name: DTLplotdisplayYticklabel
macros.doc: This command encapsulates the y-tick labels.

macros.name: DTLplotlegendname
macros.doc: Database label in legend.

macros.name: DTLplotlegendsetname
macros.doc: This will make \DTLplotlegendname use ⟨text⟩ instead of ⟨db-name⟩.

macros.name: DTLplotlegendsetxlabel
macros.doc: This will make \DTLplotlegendx use ⟨text⟩ instead of the column header for the given column key.

macros.name: DTLplotlegendsetylabel
macros.doc: This will make \DTLplotlegendy use ⟨text⟩ instead of the column header for the given column key.

macros.name: DTLplotlegendxy
macros.doc: This command is used to produce the ⟨x-header⟩ / ⟨y-header⟩ part where there are multiple x column keys.

macros.name: DTLplotlegendxysep
macros.doc: The separator between the ⟨x-header⟩ and ⟨y-header⟩.

macros.name: DTLplotlinecolors
macros.doc: The expansion text of this command should be a comma-separated list of colours (suitable for use in the argument of \color).

macros.name: DTLplotlines
macros.doc: The expansion text of this command should be a comma-separated list of line styles.

macros.name: DTLplotmarkcolors
macros.doc: Expands to a comma-separated list of colour specifications for plot marks.

macros.name: DTLplotmarks
macros.doc: \DTLplotmarks contains a list of plot marks used by \DTLplot.

macros.name: DTLplotstream
macros.doc: Adds data from columns identified by ⟨x-key⟩ and ⟨y-key⟩ from the given database to the current pgf plot stream.

macros.name: DTLticklabeloffset
macros.doc: The offset from the axis to the tick label is given by \DTLticklabeloffset.

macros.name: DTLticklength
macros.doc: Dimension that specifies length of the tick marks.

macros.name: DTLXAxisStyle
macros.doc: The style of the x axis is given by \DTLXAxisStyle.

macros.name: DTLYAxisStyle
macros.doc: The style of the y axis is given by \DTLYAxisStyle.
